items.title: How to take over a design built in Figma Make and develop it with Claude Code
items.excerpt: A step-by-step account of exporting a prototype built in Figma Make and continuing implementation in Claude Code, covering how to hand off the generated code, assets and design intent.

items.title: I saw NVIDIA's new AI video tool: why RTX Spark's half-frame trick might actually matter... and why creatives are right to be wary
items.excerpt: NVIDIA generates half the frames and lets local RTX Spark AI infer the rest: a Full HD two-second clip drops from about 6m30s to about 1m25s, with offline interpolation avoiding real-time frame-gen artefacts.

items.title: AI in Product teams: In 2026, the growing impact on collaboration
items.excerpt: A master's-thesis follow-up arguing companies have moved past piecemeal AI tool handouts into structured strategies, blurring design/engineering roles and shrinking team sizes.

items.title: DESIGN.md — a shared UI design guide for working with AI
items.excerpt: Explains DESIGN.md, a repo-root markdown file that hands an AI agent the design system - tokens, type ramp, spacing, component rules - so generated UI stays on-brand.

items.title: This AI Turns Insane Ideas Into 3D Objects
items.excerpt: Tripo 2.0 turns almost any image into a full 3D model exportable to Blender, Unreal Engine or a 3D printer.

items.title: Reading and writing are interfaces. And AI can reduce their friction.
items.excerpt: Argues reading and writing are themselves interfaces, so the question is not whether AI reduces work but where the intellectual work moves.

items.title: I audited 20 design systems for spacing drift. Here is what your team can use from it.
items.excerpt: An audit of 20 design systems measuring how spacing scales drift in practice, with a checklist teams can reuse.

items.title: 13 Designs that Inspired MIT Professor Zach Lieberman I Source Material
items.excerpt: Figma's new weekly Source Material series opens with computational artist Zach Lieberman walking through the books and systems behind his generative practice.

items.title: AI canvas, Synthetic self, The prompt is the product
items.excerpt: Weekly curated roundup for designers on agentic canvases, design-system AI-readiness evals and prompts as product surface.

items.title: New CG software you may have missed: 7 September 2026
items.excerpt: Nine tool updates including Reallusion's AI Studio 1.1, which becomes a standalone 3D-guided AI rendering app driving Seedance 2.0/2.5, plus 3DGS Render 5.1 and RealityScan Mobile 1.9.

items.title: Open-Source Substance 3D Painter Alternative ArmorPaint 1.0 Released
items.excerpt: ArmorPaint 1.0 ships with Neural Nodes for local generative AI upscaling, photo-to-material and text-to-image.

items.title: Companies are spending millions rewiring how AI gets used. Almost none can prove it's working.
items.excerpt: Enterprises are surging token spend without proving ROI - 'tokenmaxxing' - and few can measure whether the rewiring works.
